There is no per-pixel class channel anywhere in the registry.

sense.mesh.note: SpatialDDS is the carriage, not the camera. Its core profile publishes geometry tiles of 3D tile data, and heavy content such as meshes and point clouds travels as referenced blobs rather than inline messages, so a reconstruction made on one device can reach every other subscriber on the bus. What it does not do is make the reconstruction: the sensing is somebody else's, and the specification is deliberately codec-agnostic about the mesh format.
